description: Several corrections, including a correction of a future plan.

corrections: move to Mumbai postponed from November to January
key.recurring_worry: back-to-back meetings leaving no time for real work, 4 conversations

messages: Hi, I'm Arjun. I work in product operations at a logistics company in Delhi.
My manager Priya is supportive and my team has eight people.
My calendar is full of meetings, I barely get to do actual work.
Okay, that's all for now.
Seven meetings today and none of them needed me.
I did my real work after nine in the evening.
Good night.
Went cycling by the river on Sunday.
I'm planning to move to Mumbai in November for a new role.
Talk soon.
Another day of back-to-back calls and no focus time.
I miss having one clear hour to think.
Bye for now.
I cooked rajma chawal for friends.
They loved it.
That's all.
I've started looking at flats in Mumbai online.
Prices are shocking.
Good night.
I need to fix a few things I told you earlier.
My manager is not Priya, it's Pooja. Priya is a colleague on another team.
Also my team has five people, not eight. I was counting people I just work with.
And the move to Mumbai is not in November anymore, it got postponed to January.
My company delayed the new role by two months.
So I'll stay in Delhi until the end of the year.
I'm slightly relieved about the extra time.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
Pooja blocked two hours of focus time for me every day.
It's the first time in months I finished a report during working hours.
Talk soon.
The meetings crept back this week, five on Tuesday alone.
I wish people would use email.
Goodnight.
Went cycling again, 30 km this time.
I'm saving for the Mumbai deposit.
Good night.
Another heavy-meeting day, I had no time to think.
Pooja said she will help cut some meetings.
See you.
Cooked dal tonight and it was fine.
Nothing else new.
Thanks for listening.

probes.question: What is my manager's name?
probes.expected: Pooja (corrected from Priya; Priya is a colleague).

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention the Mumbai move being postponed to January; maybe corrected manager/team facts.

probes.question: Is my problem with too many meetings a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
When am I moving to Mumbai?
probes.expected: January (postponed from November); not yet happened.

probes.question: How many people are on my team?
